author: TommoDotCommo
description: Online co-op for MDK2 HD by TommoDotCommo: one player hosts, friends join over Steam or direct UDP, and you play the campaign together with shared enemies, doors and pickups. Alpha.

needs: Your own copy of MDK2 HD on Steam, or the Overhaul Games (Beamdog) version.
steps: Press Open the mod's page, download the newest zip and unzip it anywhere (not inside the game folder).
Open MDK2-Coop-Setup.exe and choose Install / Repair.
Start MDK2 HD as usual: the mod's own launcher opens first, where you host, join or play solo.
tips: It is an alpha: expect rough edges, and report problems on its GitHub page.
Everyone needs the same version of the mod.
